requirement: Chinese evidence presented as source text must actually occur on the cited page of the staged document.
source_evidence: input/task_brief.md lines 16-17 state “the original Chinese text that proves the issue” and “a location marker with document name and page number”; lines 22-23 state: “`input/source_documents/` contains the original PDFs.” and “`input/extracted_text/` contains page-labeled UTF-8 text extracted from the PDFs for easier search.”
evidence: Parsed all 17 backtick-delimited Chinese evidence entries and selected their cited `=== Page N ===` sections. Sixteen entries were exact matches after Unicode/whitespace normalization. The remaining Announcement page 2 entry explicitly uses `……` omission separators: its Buyer 2 name, share-count, and price fragments occur on page 2, while the same page’s table lines 51-53 contain `协议转让对价`, an intervening extraction-order label `价款支付方式`, and `146,660,323.00`; inspection of the corresponding public PDF page confirmed these as the table field and value. The quote’s omission markers were therefore handled as fragment separators rather than required source characters.
observed: 17/17 Chinese evidence entries are attributable to their cited pages; 16 normalize to direct exact containment and 1 is a table-layout/ellipsis case confirmed from the cited PDF page.
expected: Every quoted Chinese excerpt is present on its cited page and is attributed to the correct document.

evidence: Cross-comparison of the five fixed sampled pages found no omitted contradiction among their directly comparable transaction facts: Announcement page 1, Buyer 1 Report page 4, Buyer 2 Report page 4, and Seller Report page 4 consistently state transfers of 11,281,564 shares (5%) to each buyer and the seller’s reduction from 36.15% to 26.15%; Seller Report page 11 consistently states RMB 146,660,332.00 for each transfer and the same share counts. Findings relying partly on sampled pages are genuine when combined with their other cited pages: Finding 1 contrasts Seller Report page 11’s `146,660,332.00` with Announcement page 2’s `146,660,323.00`; Finding 5 uses Announcement page 1 and Seller Report page 4 as confirmation that the transferor is/remains the controlling shareholder, contradicting Announcement pages 2 and 15’s statement that the transaction does not involve it. The other three findings are supported by their cited nonsampled pages.
observed: No material contradiction is directly demonstrated solely among the five sampled pages; all report findings touching sampled pages are supported by affirmative conflicting statements elsewhere in their cited evidence.
expected: All sampled-page findings are semantically supported, and no material inconsistency directly demonstrated by the sampled pages is omitted.
